description: Stereo mixer strip with a level CV on each bus send, adding its input to three stereo buses, blue, orange and red, carried on one polyphonic cable from BUS IN to BUS OUT

params.text: Turns the input on and off with a fade; ctrl-click skips the fade, and a press held for 0.7 seconds auditions this strip and mutes every other Glue the Giant mixer strip in the patch
Attenuates the pan CV before it is added to the PAN knob; at full travel a 5V swing carries the pan from centre to one edge of the field
Sets the pan position of the input across the stereo field, by a constant-power law that leaves the centre at unity, with the attenuated pan CV added to it
Makes the red LEVEL knob scale the blue LEVEL knob as well, so the blue send follows the red fader; pressing it again leaves the blue send independent
Makes the red LEVEL knob scale the orange LEVEL knob as well, so the orange send follows the red fader; pressing it again leaves the orange send independent
Sets the level of the input sent to the blue stereo bus
Sets the level of the input sent to the orange stereo bus
Sets the level of the input sent to the red stereo bus

inputs.text: The left channel of the input when R is patched; with R empty, every channel of the cable arriving here is summed and fed to both sides
The right channel of the input; patching here stops the L/M/P jack from being summed and fed to both sides
A rising edge past 1V turns the input on or off, with the same fade the ON button uses, except while an audition is running
Moves the pan away from the PAN knob position, scaled by the pan attenuator; with that attenuator at full, 5V reaches hard right and -5V hard left
Scales the blue LEVEL knob, silent at 0V and full at 10V; with nothing patched the jack reads 10V, so the knob alone sets the level
Scales the orange LEVEL knob, silent at 0V and full at 10V; with nothing patched the jack reads 10V, so the knob alone sets the level
Scales the red LEVEL knob, silent at 0V and full at 10V; with nothing patched the jack reads 10V, so the knob alone sets the level
Takes the three stereo buses from another module's BUS OUT; what arrives here reaches BUS OUT unchanged by anything on this strip

outputs.text: Carries the three stereo buses as six channels on one polyphonic cable, blue then orange then red, left before right, each the sum of what arrived at BUS IN and this strip's send into that bus

notes: nothing is heard from this module on its own: its only output is the polyphonic cable at BUS OUT, and that has to be carried on to a Bus Depot, whose MIX OUT jacks sum the three buses to stereo
the blue and orange LEVEL knobs start at 0 and the red one starts at full, so a freshly placed strip feeds the red bus only until the other two are raised
holding any ON button for 0.7 seconds puts every Glue the Giant mixer strip in the patch into audition, this one heard and the rest muted; a single click on any of their ON buttons ends it
menu: In — a slider under the Fade Automation heading setting how long the ON button takes to bring the input up, 26ms to 34 seconds
Out — a slider under the Fade Automation heading setting how long the ON button takes to take the input down, 26ms to 34 seconds
Preamps on L/M/P/R Inputs — multiplies the input before the pan and level knobs, choosing between No gain (default), 2x gain, 4x gain and 8x gain
Pan CV Filter — chooses No filter or Smoothing (default), which slews the pan CV over 52ms from one edge of the field to the other and takes the clicks off a fast CV
Level CV Filters — chooses No filter or Smoothing (default), which slews each level CV over 26ms from silence to full and takes the clicks off a stepped CV
Blue and Orange Levels — Default to normal faders and Default to post fader sends set whether a newly placed module starts with its two POST FADER buttons on
